Privacy

Information about how the current COLAVA page operates.

Operator

COLAVA is a project by Altered Venganza, Trieste, Italy. VAT number 01433140322.

Data on this page

The page contains no signup forms, analytics or advertising pixels. Reading previews does not require an email address. Hosting services may process technical connection data, such as IP addresses and HTTP requests, to deliver and secure the site.

Device preferences

Your preferences choice is stored in your browser for 180 days. Language is remembered only if you enable that option. Change your choice through the footer or remove stored data in your browser settings.

External services

Supplier and Stripe links open external services with their own privacy notices. This page does not receive or store card numbers.

Notice being completed

Before sales open, the privacy contact, operator address and details of order-data processing and retention need to be completed. This information describes the current page and is not yet the full notice for future sales operations.
